job: Fan out from an overview to the pages beneath it with link cards.
purpose: A grid of fd-card[data-interactive] items, each with an icon, a title and one line. They are flush with the page until hovered. The grid has one to six columns and collapses on narrow widths. The icon is a plain glyph, never a logo.
useWhen: A docs overview or an intro page leads to three to six places to read next.
A section index lists its pages with a line each.

avoidWhen.when: A catalog of items with media, price or state.
A list of guides with time to read.
Related links at the end of an article.

variants.useWhen: Two cards across: the default for paired choices such as Search and Interact.
Three across for a short overview.
Four across on a wide landing page.
Six across for a dense list of products.
